Hands-on experience implementing RAG systems, embedding models, vector databases, and semantic retrieval strategies. Familiarity with containerization (Docker), REST/gRPC API development (e.g., FastAPI), and model serving/evaluation workflows. Demonstrated ability to break down complex domain problems, rapidly prototype AI solutions, benchmark performance, and iterate toward production-quality implementations. Familiarity with graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, Apache AGE) and knowledge graph-augmented retrieval. Familiarity with C/C++, compiler concepts, or GPU profiling/acceleration (CUDA). Background or curiosity in digital logic design, SystemVerilog, hardware verification, or Electronic Design Automation (EDA) tools. Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation frameworks (e.g., Ragas, TruLens, DeepEval) and experiment tracking platforms (MLflow, Weights & Biases).
